Reuben_1: firstborn son of Jacob (Genesis 29:32), son of Leah
Simeon_1: second-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:33), son of Leah
Levi_1: third-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:34), son of Leah
Judah_1: fourth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:35), son of Leah
Naphtali_1: sixth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:7), son of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid
Gad_1: seventh-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:11, Genesis 35:26), son of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid
Asher_1: eighth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:11, Genesis 35:26), son of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid
Issachar_1: ninth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:17), son of Leah
Zebulun_1: tenth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:19), son of Leah
Joseph_1: eleventh-born son of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 30:24)
Benjamin_1: twelfth-born son of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 35:18)
